description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 截图翻译可以用其他翻译插件：先用官方的“翻译”，没设好服务或没翻成功就换下一个；翻译插件装了但关着时，直接提示并给一个按钮打开它（#340）。截图设置的“按键”页列出截图时和编辑图片时的全部固定按键，补上漏掉的 F 键（#342）。编号工具图标里的“1”居中。权限不变。
notes.en: Screenshot translation works through any plugin that can translate: the official Translate first, the next when one has no service set up or fails; a translator installed but switched off is said so, with a button that turns it on (#340). The Keys page of the capture settings lists every fixed key of capturing and editing, with the missing F key added (#342). The 1 in the numbering icon is centred. Permissions unchanged.
